As Apple (AAPL) Valuation Declined, Holder Louisiana State Employees Retirement System Has Lowered Stake; Acropolis Investment Management Holds Stake in Microsoft (MSFT) 
April 18, 2018 - By Darrin Black 
Louisiana State Employees Retirement System decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 3.63% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Louisiana State Employees Retirement System sold 11,700 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 310,800 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $52.60 million, down from 322,500 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Louisiana State Employees Retirement System who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $904.39B market cap company. The stock increased 1.38% or $2.42   $178.24. About 23.70M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49%   uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500. 
Acropolis Investment Management Llc increased its stake in Microsoft Corp (MSFT) by 54.97% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Acropolis Investment Management Llc bought 13,414 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.63% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 37,818 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.24M, up from 24,404 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Acropolis Investment Management Llc who had been investing in Microsoft Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $739.72B market cap company. The stock increased 2.02% or $1.9   $96.07. About 22.73M shares traded. Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) has risen 37.43%   uptrending. It has outperformed by 25.88% the S&P500. 
Louisiana State Employees Retirement System, which manages about $2.20 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in First Horizon Natl Corp (NYSE:FHN) by 19,600 shares to 82,100 shares, valued at $1.64M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Cognex Corp (NASDAQ:CGNX) by 20,700 shares in the quarter, for a total of 43,800 shares, and has risen its stake in Insperity Inc (NYSE:NSP). 
Since December 7, 2017, it had 0 buys, and 4 selling transactions for $19.89 million activity. Shares for $11.56M were sold by SCHILLER PHILIP W.

AAPL’s profit will be $13.75B for 16.44 P/E if the $2.71 EPS becomes a reality. After $3.89 actual EPS reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -30.33% negative EPS growth.
